rootCause.observed: Production snapshots include recent document.set -501001 ResourceUnavailable.TransactionConflict errors despite the existing SDK code mapping.
rootCause.limits: Latest error fields and lifetime max intervals do not prove every overnight failure or max interval was caused by conflict.
rootCause.sdk: Pinned wx-server-sdk 4.0.2 and @cloudbase/database 1.5.1: default retry count 3 means four attempts. The default recursive loop neither waits nor aborts each failed attempt before retry. Wrapped callback mapping does not catch raw ResourceUnavailable.TransactionConflict returned by commit.

changes: Use db.runTransaction(callback, 0), preserving four total attempts with explicit-conflict-only retry after the SDK rollback path.
Jitter waits 25-49, 50-99, 100-199 ms; total additional waiting 175-347 ms. Generic/uncertain writes and commits are never replayed. No message-send retry added.
Successful upstream observations do not rewrite an already-clean closed breaker. Real failure reset, probe ownership, expiration, generation and cooldown behavior remain checked.

newRegressionAgainstPreviousCode.meaning: Real SDK get/set/canonical commit conflict cases leave one un-aborted transaction; raw ResourceUnavailable commit fails; healthy outcomes rewrite clean breaker.

remaining: Short production window cannot establish an all-day strict 60-second SLA; persistent conflicts after four attempts still fail visibly.
